name: Hayama Shinji
source:
The protagonist's older brother who raised her after their parents died 10 years ago.
He's proud of his ability to act as her father, mother, and older brother, but he has a pretty extreme sister complex.
He's a researcher at Hayama Pharmaceuticals where he was reunited with his friend from university and distant relative [url=/c40229]Rei[/url].
